levels.surface: تميم بن عبدالله بن تميم القرشي

notes: needs_ruling (rule 11): inside Najma's account «فَدَخَلَ إِلَيَّ أَبُوهُ مُوسَى بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ فَقَالَ لِي» the Imam speaks and acts in a narrated scene; it is not settled whether he is a source or only in the scene, so he is not added as a link
the text opens «2 -» while the context gives report number 3: read as written, not reconciled
«سَمِعْتُ اُمِّي تَقُولُ» : the mother of Ali b. Maytham, a bare relation, kind relation
«نجمة أم الرضا» is kept with its epithet as written
